<function name="ChangePitch" parent="CSoundPatch" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Adjust the pitch, also known as the speed at which the sound is being played.

Appears to only work while the sound is being played. See also <page>CSoundPatch:PlayEx</page>.

This invokes <page>GM:EntityEmitSound</page>.
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="pitch" type="number">The pitch can range from 0-255. Where 100 is the original pitch.</arg>
		<arg name="deltaTime" type="number" default="0">The time to fade from previous to the new pitch.</arg>
	</args>
</function>
